description: Returns floor plans for RF planning import including image URLs, scale (pixels per meter), and coordinate origin. Optionally filter by siteId.

queryParameters.name: siteId
queryParameters.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

children.name: image_url
children.description: Floor plan image path at `/proxy/innerspace/integration/v1/assets/{planId}/{filename}`. Requires the same session auth headers as this endpoint. Prepend the API origin (e.g. api.ui.com connector prefix) to fetch.

children.name: ppm
children.description: Pixels per meter (`ppm`). Required to interpret coordinates and heights.

children.name: width
children.description: Floor plan image width in pixels. Omitted when unknown.

children.name: height
children.description: Floor plan image height in pixels. Omitted when unknown.

children.name: origin_x
children.description: X coordinate of the floor plan origin in pixels (0 when coordinates use top-left image origin).

children.name: origin_y
children.description: Y coordinate of the floor plan origin in pixels (0 when coordinates use top-left image origin).

children.name: site_id
children.description: UniFi site ID when `siteId` query filter is applied.

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/innerspace/integration/v1/floor_plans?siteId=%7BsiteId%7D", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: List floor plans
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.innerspace:
    path: "/v1/floor_plans"
    method: GET
    query:
      siteId: "{siteId}"
  register: result

- debug:
    var: result.data
